target_decision: retain the measure-theoretic Lusin family and require source selection and review before exact statement work
statement_blocker: The catalog gives only a relation gloss. It does not select Lusin's printed interval theorem, a finite Radon-measure closed or compact restriction, or a global continuous-representative formulation. It omits domain and topology, measure and finiteness, codomain, measurability notion, epsilon binder, large-set predicate, continuity/equality conclusion, and boundary cases. The matching 1912 note contains several distinct theorems and is not cited by the catalog. Selecting a familiar variant would invent or substitute mathematics.

conclusion: Open: the repository does not choose a perfect nowhere-dense interval subset, a large closed/compact subset with relative continuity, or a global continuous function agreeing outside a small exceptional set.
degenerate_case_status: No case is excluded before a proposition is selected; empty/null/infinite domains, epsilon boundaries, extended values, separation/countability failures, and trivial large sets remain statement decisions.

continuous-function density in Lp or convergence in measure
measure inner regularity without continuity of the function
